style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Faux Norfolk Pine Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Bring timeless greenery into your home with this beautifully crafted 183cm faux Norfolk pine garland. Designed to capture the soft, feathery texture of real Norfolk pine, this lifelike garland offers a fresh, natural look without any of the upkeep. Its generous length makes it perfect for draping effortlessly across mantels, staircases, doorways or dining tables, instantly creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The rich green tones and delicately layered branches add depth and realism, making it a versatile styling piece that looks just as beautiful on its own as it does when dressed with lights, ribbons or seasonal accents. Measuring 183cm in length, this garland features full, soft-touch foliage that enhances its realistic appearance, ensuring it can be reused year after year. Ideal for both festive decorating and year-round display, it stays lush and vibrant without shedding or maintenance. Effortlessly elevate your décor with a touch of evergreen charm that never fades. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: L183cm.
